summary: A compact, high-profile Nimman espresso bar known for elaborate latte art, ristretto-led drinks and creative signature coffees. It is a worthwhile short stop for coffee fans; food is secondary and the small space can feel busy.
whyGo: Watch skilled baristas make distinctive latte art and choose among classic espresso drinks and creative signatures.
It is an easy coffee stop while exploring Nimman rather than a destination requiring a full-day plan.
bestFor: A short café stop in Nimman
skipIf: You need a substantial meal or a quiet, spacious place to work
You need step-free access or verified accessible facilities
duration: Allow about 30–60 minutes as a planning estimate; longer if busy or waiting for a table.
cost: Recent listings and customer reports put common drinks around ฿80–฿100, with a reported latte at ฿88; specialty drinks may cost more. Treat this as an indicative range and check the menu on arrival. Food is not the main draw.
hours: Current listings conflict: the Thailand Tourism Authority lists 07:00–18:00 daily and Wongnai lists 07:00–17:30 daily, while a specialty-coffee directory lists Wednesday closed and 07:00–17:30 on other days. Confirm directly before setting out, especially on Wednesday.
bestTime: Go early in the day for coffee and a better chance of seating. It is a popular café and queues or a crowded compact room are possible; no dependable December wait-time data was found.
gettingThere: At 15/3 Nimmanahaeminda Road in the Nimman area, close to Nimman Soi 3. Use a ride-hailing car, songthaew or taxi and show the address; the area is walkable once there. There is no dedicated parking listed, so do not rely on finding a convenient roadside space.
booking: No booking requirement or reservation channel was found. Plan to walk in; expect possible waits at busy times.
accessibility: Step-free entry, accessible toilet and seating access are not documented in the sources checked. The café is described as compact and sits directly on a busy road; contact the venue in advance if mobility access is important. No clear dietary or allergen policy was found. Ask staff about milk alternatives, non-coffee drinks and ingredients before ordering.
practicalTips: Address: 15/3 Nimmanahaeminda Road, Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai 50200; phone +66 53 215 278.
Recent listed examples include flat white ฿80 and latte ฿77 on the menu listing; a 2025 customer report gives ฿88 for a latte. Confirm current prices at the counter.
Choose a signature drink or espresso-based coffee if the barista craft is the main reason for visiting; use a nearby restaurant for a full meal.
There is Wi-Fi and limited seating per a local listing, but the compact, busy setting may not suit a long laptop session.
decemberNotes: December is within Chiang Mai's busy high season, so allow flexibility for seating and traffic in Nimman. No special December 2026 opening schedule or event was published in the sources checked. Verify hours close to the visit because listings conflict and holiday hours may differ.
uncertainties: Opening hours conflict across current listings, including whether the café closes on Wednesdays; confirm with the venue shortly before visiting.
Prices are based on recent third-party menu listings and customer reports, not a dated official menu, and may change before December 2026.
Accessibility, dietary accommodation, queue length and reservation policy were not verified from an official venue source.
